description: This file provides a singleton factory implementation for creating MQTT v5 asynchronous clients using HiveMQ, configured with connection parameters and optional event listeners, within a larger Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultHiveMqtt5ClientFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class for creating configured MQTT v5 client instances for communication within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DefaultHiveMqtt5ClientFactory.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MQTT v5 asynchronous client with specified connection parameters and event listeners.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Builds and returns a configured Mqtt5ClientBuilder with connection details, optional auth, and event listeners.
